prompt: What was the running time of the first cartoon in the series that inspired the name of the Looney Tunes franchise?
answer: The first cartoon in **Silly Symphonies**, the series that inspired the name *Looney Tunes*, was **_The Skeleton Dance_ (1929)**. Its running time was approximately **5 minutes 23 seconds**.
